world: Paint one unified storyboard image, four panels across and four down, in shot order, with plain gutters and no written marks anywhere. Dinu is a smooth, solid-red artist's mannequin of medium-tall, lean build; all human figures, including those inside the photograph, use the same smooth mannequin treatment. The compact right-hand-drive cash van has a dark grey moulded dashboard, worn black vinyl seats, rubber mats and a solid steel partition behind the cab. A thin, knotted red cotton thread remains around Dinu's left wrist. One slightly scuffed black smartphone stays secured upright on the central dashboard within left-hand reach, immediately left of the fixed, faded photograph. Rain beads cover the windows; cool blue-green instrument light and narrow sodium-orange light from the driver's side shape the cabin, with deep blacks and a restrained, uneasy grade. Props and surroundings are painted realistically; phone controls use simple symbols without lettering.
geography: The road lies beyond the front windscreen, with the central dashboard beneath it, the steering wheel directly ahead of the right-hand driver's seat, and the steel partition behind both front seats. The empty passenger seat is on the left. Dinu remains in this single cabin zone throughout: the broad and oblique views look across from the passenger side, keeping him frame right and his forward direction toward screen left; the tight near-frontal views stand farther forward beside the windscreen and look back toward him, with the road just beyond the lens. Dashboard inserts look forward and right from the passenger side without crossing the driver's forward axis. The phone and photograph never exchange positions. Outside, wet Colombo streets continue along the original course through panel 14; panel 15 still opens before the steering change, while panel 16 belongs to the new course toward the industrial area.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, viewed from the front passenger position
panels.camera: Passenger-side three-quarter view at seated head height, 35mm medium-wide cabin master. Dinu occupies frame right; the wheel is low centre and the dashboard extends left.
panels.background: Rain-covered windscreen and dense soft road lights fill upper left. The driver's side window is behind Dinu at right, with a narrow dark partition edge at far right.
panels.picture: The red mannequin sits frame right with chest square to the wheel and head aligned toward the road, seen three-quarter toward screen left. His left hand grips the left rim and his right hand grips the right rim. The central dashboard occupies lower left, but the small photograph and dark phone are too small and dim to reveal their contents.

panels.camera: At seated head height beside the passenger seat, looking obliquely across the cabin; 65mm medium close-up. Upper wheel rim touches the lower edge.
panels.background: The rain-covered driver's window fills the background behind and right of Dinu. Crowded orange and blue-green light shapes remain soft, with dark cabin trim at far right.
panels.picture: Dinu's red head, upper chest and shoulders occupy centre-right, with chest facing the wheel and head directed forward toward screen left. Both hands remain on the wheel, with only portions of the grips visible along the bottom edge. The dashboard keepsake and phone are outside this tighter crop.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, forward passenger-side close setup
panels.camera: At seated head height near the passenger-side windscreen, looking back toward the driver without crossing his forward axis; 85mm near-frontal close-up of head and shoulder.
panels.background: A narrow strip of wet driver's window appears frame left with small crowded light circles. The steel partition falls into darkness at frame right.
panels.picture: The smooth red head fills the centre above a narrow band of shoulder and upper chest. Chest and head remain aligned with the wheel and road just past the lens, without a sideways head turn. Both hands are on the wheel below the crop.

panels.camera: Low dashboard-level oblique view from the passenger side, looking forward and right; 75mm insert with enough depth to resolve the printed photograph.
panels.background: Dark grey dashboard moulding surrounds the print. A soft band of rain-covered windscreen and orange road lights runs along the top, while the secured phone's edge appears at left.
panels.picture: The faded printed photograph fills the centre, fixed flat against the dashboard with its edges clearly visible. Inside the print, a tiny red mannequin for Dinu and a neutral-grey mannequin for Aruni stand beside a village bus shelter, their chests and heads directed toward the photograph's viewpoint, arms down and hands empty. The shelter has a simple roof, bench and post without lettering.

panels.camera: Return to the passenger-side three-quarter position at seated head height; 35mm medium shot, retaining the photograph low left.
panels.background: The wet windscreen and diffuse street lights occupy upper left. The driver's window remains behind Dinu at right, with the partition edge in shadow at far right.
panels.picture: Dinu sits frame right, chest facing the wheel and head held forward toward screen left. Both hands grip the wheel, with the red thread resting against the left rim. The faded photograph is now identifiable low left, with the same secured phone farther left; Dinu's head is not turned toward either object.

panels.zone: Central dashboard and near edge of the steering wheel
panels.camera: Dashboard-level oblique insert from the passenger side, 75mm with moderate depth. The phone fills centre, and the wheel enters at the right edge.
panels.background: The faded photograph enters at the right edge behind the phone's plane. Wet windscreen reflections form a narrow soft strip above the dashboard.
panels.picture: The secured black phone displays a large, unlettered circular playback control with a simple triangular symbol. Dinu's left hand is still gripping the wheel at frame right, its knotted red wrist thread clearly visible. No hand touches the phone in this opening picture.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, forward passenger-side close setup
panels.camera: At seated head height near the passenger-side windscreen; 85mm near-frontal close-up, including the head and a small amount of upper shoulder.
panels.background: Wet side-window reflections form a soft strip at left. A compact orange light cluster sits high in that strip, while the partition remains dark at right.
panels.picture: Dinu's smooth red head is held upright in the centre, directed along the road just past the lens. His upper chest remains square to the wheel, with both hands on it below the crop. A narrow orange band crosses the side of the head above the cooler blue-green shoulder light.

panels.camera: At seated head height from the passenger side; 65mm medium close-up with the wheel edge low in frame.
panels.background: The rain-covered driver's window fills the space behind Dinu at centre-right. Soft orange lights are spread horizontally beyond it, with black trim along the far-right edge.
panels.picture: The red mannequin occupies centre-right in three-quarter profile, chest facing the wheel and head pointing forward toward screen left. Both hands grip the wheel at the lower frame edge. The head remains aligned with the driving task rather than turned toward the dashboard phone.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, forward passenger-side close setup
panels.camera: At seated head height near the windscreen; 85mm near-frontal close-up, slightly tighter on the head than panel 7 while retaining one shoulder edge.
panels.background: The wet window strip at left contains a low orange reflection and scattered cool light circles. Deep partition shadow occupies frame right.
panels.picture: The smooth red head fills most of the panel, held forward toward the road just past the lens. A thin portion of upper chest shows that the body remains square to the wheel; both hands are below the crop on its rim. Cool instrument light now covers most of the head, with only a narrow orange edge.

panels.camera: Passenger-side dashboard-level oblique, 75mm insert. The secured handset and its screen dominate the panel.
panels.background: Dashboard moulding lies below and around the phone, with the faded photograph partially visible at right. Soft wet-windscreen reflections occupy the upper edge.
panels.picture: The same scuffed black phone stands fixed in its dashboard mount. Its softly illuminated dark screen shows an incoming-call layout using a plain circular symbol and separate green and red call controls, without letters or numbers. No hand enters the frame.

panels.camera: Passenger-side three-quarter view at seated head height, 35mm medium shot. Dinu is right, wheel centre and lit phone left.
panels.background: The windscreen carries rain beads and blurred road lamps across upper left. The driver's side window and a dark partition edge remain behind Dinu at right.
panels.picture: Dinu sits frame right with chest square to the wheel and head directed forward toward screen left. Both hands are still on the wheel in this opening frame, the left wrist thread visible near the rim. The secured phone glows at left with its unlettered incoming-call controls, beside the fixed photograph.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, forward passenger-side close setup
panels.camera: At seated head height near the passenger-side windscreen; 85mm near-frontal close-up of the head and shoulder.
panels.background: A thin wet-window strip at left holds a few compressed orange light circles. The steel partition forms a nearly black field at right.
panels.picture: The red head occupies the centre, held straight toward the road just past the lens. The upper chest remains aligned with the wheel, and both hands stay on its rim below the crop. Sodium light forms a narrow vertical edge on the head while blue-green instrument light reaches the shoulder.

panels.camera: Passenger-side oblique view at seated head height, 65mm medium close-up. The wheel rim and both grips enter along the lower edge.
panels.background: The wet driver's window remains behind Dinu at right, carrying compressed orange road-light reflections. Dark interior trim closes the far-right edge.
panels.picture: Dinu's red upper body sits centre-right, chest facing the wheel and head aligned forward toward screen left. His left and right hands retain their separate grips on the rim. The head stays clear of the phone's direction, with no reaching hand in the frame.

panels.camera: At seated head height from the passenger side, 50mm medium shot wide enough to include the head, upper body, both hands and upper wheel.
panels.background: Rain-streaked driver's glass fills the area behind Dinu at right. Soft city lights remain dense beyond it, with no distinct industrial structure visible.
panels.picture: Dinu sits centre-right with chest square to the wheel and head still directed forward toward screen left. Both hands remain on the rim, placing the knotted red thread on his left wrist clearly at low centre. His head has not yet tilted down toward the thread.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, central dashboard and road ahead
panels.camera: Passenger-side three-quarter view at seated head height, 35mm medium-wide cabin master. Dinu stays frame right, with wheel centre and the road visible upper left.
panels.background: The wet road continues ahead through the windscreen at upper left. Indistinct low roof shapes lie far beyond the roadway, while the driver's wet side window and dark partition edge remain at right.
panels.picture: The red mannequin faces forward toward screen left, chest square to the wheel and head aligned with the road. Both hands hold the wheel in its original-course position, with the thread on the left wrist. The fixed phone and photograph remain together on the central dashboard at left; the opening frame does not yet show a steering change.

panels.zone: Driver's seat, forward passenger-side close setup
panels.camera: At seated head height near the passenger-side windscreen; 85mm near-frontal close-up of the head and shoulder, preserving the established side of the axis.
panels.background: The wet side-window strip remains at left, now containing fewer, more widely spaced industrial-area light points. The same steel partition stays dark at right.
panels.picture: Dinu's smooth red head fills the centre, directed along the new road just past the lens. His upper chest remains square to the wheel, with both hands on it below the crop. Broad cool light covers the head and shoulder, broken by a small orange edge rather than the earlier dense city reflections.

conflicts: Shot 4 places the phone left of the photograph, while shot 6 places the photograph left of the phone. Both props must remain fixed, so the board keeps the shot 4 arrangement and places the photograph at the right edge of panel 6.
Shot 10 requests readable caller identification, but the storyboard rules prohibit drawn text. Panel 10 therefore shows an unlettered incoming-call interface without a caller name.
Shots 1 and 15 are labelled MS, while their camera framing specifies MWS. Their panels use the wider cabin framing specified by the camera plans.
